name: Windows Settings Manager Lite
blocker: Automated build/test/native Windows smoke/Elgato validation/package and deterministic media gates pass. Remaining blockers are physical HDR/multi-monitor/laptop/sleep-resume/reboot/external-state/physical Stream Deck profile QA plus final Marketplace media review; after Pro publication, Lite also requires verified direct Lite/Pro Marketplace URLs and the strict routing audit.
final_boundary: Complete products/windows-settings-manager/QA.md on real Windows hardware and physical Stream Deck devices, review Marketplace media, publish Pro first, record verified direct Lite/Pro Marketplace URLs/IDs, pass tools/lite_pro_audit.py --shipping windows-settings-manager-lite, then move Lite to READY_TO_SHIP.
release_gate: HDR supported/unsupported and multi-monitor physical validation
sleep/resume/reboot and Stream Deck restart validation
external Windows state change refresh validation
strict Lite to Pro Marketplace routing audit after Pro publication
bundled profile archive/action/navigation integrity across seven device families

upsell.release_order: publish Pro first, then record direct Pro and Lite Marketplace URLs before Lite publication

commercial_release_boundary: After technical/physical QA passes, publish Pro first. Lite remains BLOCKED until Pro is published, both exact direct Marketplace URLs/IDs are recorded in products/lite-pro-map.json, the rebuilt Lite package contains the exact Pro URL, and tools/lite_pro_audit.py --shipping windows-settings-manager-lite passes.
